summary: Draganfly Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on November 6, 2026, solely to announce a third-quarter 2026 shareholder update and earnings call scheduled for November 10, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. EST, ahead of results released that day after market close. CEO Cameron Chell and CFO Paul Sun will present operational milestones and financial highlights; investors may pre-submit questions via investor relations. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is disclosed; the filing is a routine scheduling notice with no special-situation elements.
